description: Partially updates (PATCHes) an existing Google Calendar, modifying only the fields provided. At least one of summary, description, location, or timezone must be provided. Empty strings for `description` or `location` clear them.

calendar_id.description: The unique identifier of the Google Calendar to update. Use 'primary' for the main calendar, or a calendar's unique ID (typically in email format like 'abc123@group.calendar.google.com'). IMPORTANT: This is NOT the calendar's display name/title - use googlecalendar.list_calendars to find the 'id' field for a calendar.
calendar_id.human_parameter_description: The unique identifier of the calendar to update. Use 'primary' for your main calendar, or the calendar's unique ID (found in calendar settings or via GOOGLECALENDAR_LIST_CALENDARS). WARNING: Do NOT use the calendar's display name/title here - the ID is typically in email format (e.g., 'abc123@group.calendar.google.com').
calendar_id.title: Calendar Id

description.human_parameter_description: A short summary that describes what this calendar is for. Provide the text you want people to see when viewing the calendar.
description.title: Description

location.description: New geographic location of the calendar (e.g., 'Paris, France').
location.human_parameter_description: The city or place this calendar is associated with (for example, 'Paris, France'). This helps set context for the calendar's region; leave blank if you don't want to specify one.
location.title: Location

summary.description: New title for the calendar; cannot be an empty string when provided. At least one of summary, description, location, or timezone must be provided.
summary.human_parameter_description: The new name of the calendar that will appear in Google Calendar. Choose something clear and recognizable, like 'Team Meetings'. Leave blank to keep the current title.
summary.title: Summary

timezone.description: New IANA Time Zone Database name for the calendar (e.g., 'Europe/Zurich', 'America/New_York'). Calendars duplicated via googlecalendar.duplicate_calendar may default to UTC; set the correct timezone explicitly after duplication.
timezone.human_parameter_description: The time zone you want the calendar to use (for example, 'America/New_York'). Pick the zone where most events happen so times show correctly.
timezone.title: Timezone

name: patch_calendar

conferenceProperties.description: Conference-related settings for events in this calendar. Present when conference-related properties are configured or returned by the API.
conferenceProperties.title: Conference Properties

etag.description: ETag of the resource. Used for versioning and caching.
etag.title: Etag

id.description: Identifier of the calendar. Commonly an email address (e.g., primary calendars) or a unique opaque ID for secondary calendars.
id.title: Id

location.description: Geographic location of the calendar as free-form text.
location.title: Location

timeZone.description: The calendar’s time zone, specified as an IANA time zone ID (e.g., "America/Los_Angeles").
timeZone.title: Time Zone

allowedConferenceSolutionTypes.description: The types of conference solutions that are allowed for the calendar. If omitted, defaults may apply based on account/domain settings.
allowedConferenceSolutionTypes.title: Allowed Conference Solution Types

display_url.description: Direct URL to view this calendar in the Google Calendar web interface.
display_url.title: Display Url

response_data.description: Calendar resource returned by the Google Calendar API Calendars.patch method. Represents metadata for a calendar.
response_data.title: Response Data
